description:
Introducing the P-51 Ace.
Lighter. Leaner. Just as relentless.
The Ace is built on a rugged aluminum frame and weighs in at 10 pounds less than the Bullet, making it our most agile ride yet. A forged head tube adds serious strength where it counts, and the slightly shorter wheelbase gives the Ace a distinct, responsive feel that sets it apart from anything else in the lineup.
At the center is a long seat — one of the most requested features — offering flexible riding positions whether you're solo or with a passenger. Up front, the integrated screen keeps your cockpit clean and minimal without sacrificing function.
Every detail of the Ace has been dialed for riders who want something fast, light, and built to move.
The Ace isn’t just another model — it’s a new way to ride.

Adjustable Amps: With the new and improved programming we have added an adjustably in the amps which will allow you to turn up to the amps to get more torque out of your motor. Note: You may experience a bit less range when at a higher amp draw.
Suspension: This is the P-51 difference. The Ace uses an adjustable triple clamp 27-inch KKE front fork and direct mount adjustable rear DNM piggyback coil over. Suspension travel is 200 mm in the front and 140 mm of wheel travel in the rear
Battery: High quality LG 21700 cell 48 volt - 20 AH lithium-ion battery paired with a powerful BMS. The Ace also comes with a 5 amp quick charger for fast recharge! Riders will get an estimated range 40+ miles on throttle only (varies due to riding style)
Brakes: The Ace is equipped with the legendary Magura MT5E Quad piston Hydraulic brakes front and rear and 203mm oversize rotors for increased stopping and overall brake performance
Wheels and Tires - NEW: The Ace uses 20 inch x 4 inch P-51 Alpha tires
Compliance: This bike does not need to be registered and is Class 2 compliant
